title.zh: 双对数散点与边缘直方图

source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 模拟相关散点；样本量沿用截图标签，不代表获得了原始样本
provenance.en: Seeded synthetic correlated observations. Group counts follow screenshot labels, not recovered study samples.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 每个 genome 的 ID、SAG/MAG/WGS 类别、总长度 bp 和 CDS 数量。
原始长度/计数，以及 corrected 的校正方法和质量筛选规则。
真实样本量、拟合方法、残差尺度，以及用于组间残差检验的设计。
en: Genome ID, SAG/MAG/WGS group, genome length in bp and CDS count for every record.
Uncorrected measurements, the exact correction method and quality filters.
Actual sample counts, regression method, residual scale and design for residual group comparisons.

preprocessing.zh: 先完成 corrected 校正并输入严格正值。程序在 log10 空间拟合直线和计算残差；不运行残差组间显著性检验。
preprocessing.en: Apply the correction upstream and supply strictly positive values. The code fits a line and computes residuals in log10 space; it does not run significance tests between residual groups.

description.zh: 实验组或细胞群；与样式一致
description.en: Experimental group or cell population; match style

description.zh: 已按原方法校正的基因组总长度
description.en: Genome length corrected by the original method

description.zh: 已校正的预测 CDS 数量
